test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Humayun built a city named Dinpanah in 1533 in Delhi.

options.text: A city named Dinpanah was built by Humayun in 1533 in Delhi.
A city named Dinpanah had been built by Humayun in 1533 in Delhi.
A city named Humayun was built by Dinpanah in 1533 in Delhi.
A city named Dinpanah was being built by Humayun in 1533 in Delhi.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in active voice so, we have to change it in passive voice.
 
• In the given sentence, the verb 'built' is correctly changed to 'was built' to form the passive voice.
 
• The **subject 'Humayun'** is moved to the end of the sentence and preceded by 'by'.
 
• The **object 'a city named Dinpanah'** becomes the subject of the **passive sentence**.

Hence, the correct statement is '**A city named Dinpanah was built by Humayun in 1533 in Delhi.'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** **Other given options are not correct as they are not in correct format.
